description: Free, read-only. Convert a fetched URL or an HTML string you pass (one of the two) to Markdown: headings, links, lists, emphasis, code, quotes. Drops nav, header, footer, aside, script and style. Returns text, cut at maxChars with a marker. Runs no JavaScript: SPAs return an empty shell. Tables become plain text.

html.description: HTML text to convert. Not with url.

url.description: Page URL to fetch. Not with html.

name: html_to_markdown
title: Convert HTML to Markdown
